```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Exécute tout le code contenu dans le fichier .R
source("Useful_functions.R")

```

```{r}

#We create a dataset with only the observations made in 1974 
data_1974 <- filter_target(data = dati, 
                                     variable = "anno", 
                                     target = 1974)
```

```{r}
#| label: tableau-resume
#| echo: false

board <- summary_statistics(data_1974)

knitr::kable(board, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: ma-carte
#| echo: false

# We create a map with the points where the observations have been done
map_observations(
  data = data_1974, 
  var_lon = "Lon10", 
  var_lat = "Lat10"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: variogramm-pollution
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Analyse of the spatial variance"


variogramm(
  data = data_1974,
  var_x = "XUTM",
  var_y = "YUTM",
  var_output = "totanno", 
  code_epsg = 32632
)
```

```{r}
#Now, we want to fond the optimal parameter p for the inverse distance weighted estimator

#| label: optimisation-idw
#| echo: true

resultats_opti <- optimise_p_idw(data = data_1974, 
                                  var_x = "XUTM", 
                                  var_y = "YUTM", 
                                  var_output = "totanno",
                                  code_epsg = 32632)
```

```{r}
install.packages(c("rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata"))
```

```{r}
library(rnaturalearth)
# 2. We upload the map of Italy 
borders_italie <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", country = "Italy", returnclass = "sf")
```

```{r}
#| label: carte-idw-italie
#| echo: true

grid_idw(
  data = data_1974, 
  var_x = "XUTM", 
  var_y = "YUTM", 
  var_output = "totanno",
  code_epsg = 32632, 
  param_p = 3.5,
  map = borders_italie
)
```
